messages:
jamie: heads-up — getting a steady spike of 502/504s on /v1/generate from 10:05–10:15. Pager alerted ~120 errors (502s ~100, 504s ~18). Any quick pointers where to start? sample trace id: trace-9a7c

deploy-bot: deploy finished to prod at 10:02 by marco (release/optimize-inference). No failures reported in deploy logs.

marco: Not from deploy side then. Start with the Grafana 'API / Errors' panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/api-errors. Quick Prometheus query to eyeball: ```sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job=\"api\",uri=~\"/v1/.*\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (status)``` Also check upstream_latency_ms and concurrency for the api-backend pool.

priya: Also check NGINX logs in Loki for concrete nginx messages: ```{job=\"nginx\"} |~ \"\\\"status\\\": \\"5..\\\"\" |~ \"/v1/generate\" | json``` Look for upstream errors like "upstream timed out" or "connect() failed". 504s point to upstream timeout; 502s often mean rapid connection resets.

lina: Traces in Tempo/Jaeger: https://tempo.redwood.internal/search?service=api&operation=/v1/generate — filter by trace id trace-9a7c. Inspect backend spans for >5s tail latency. If backend is saturating, we'll see many long spans and queued requests. :warning:

jamie: For alerting context — current pager 'api-5xx-rate' fires when 5xx > 0.8% over 5m. It's noisy during legitimate traffic surges. Can we relax or gate it so we only page when both error rate AND request volume are high? Suggestions?

priya: +1. Proposed rule: trigger pager only if (5xx_rate > 1% AND request_rate > 120) over 5m. Also add tag env:prod so staging/bench noise doesn't page. I'll open a PR against ops for the PagerDuty rule. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/432

marco: I'll update the Datadog monitor and Grafana alert conditions to match that SOON — changing threshold and adding request_rate condition, ETA ~25m. Will post links when done. Also adding query to exclude healthcheck endpoints.

infra-bot: Note: cpu on api-backend-1 spiked at 10:06; autoscaler triggered a scale-up at 10:08 (scale to +2 replicas).

jamie: Awesome — thanks all. I'll keep an eye and re-open if we see another burst. If Marco posts the update, I'll validate that PD didn't fire. :thumbsup:
